verdict.rationale: Bitwarden's Authenticator import/export docs list import paths from other authenticator apps: Google Authenticator via QR code, LastPass Authenticator via JSON export, and 2FAS via .2fas backup file. That directly replaces re-enrolling each account by hand. missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration of the import working, explicit confirmation that all accounts transfer in bulk in one pass, and detail on supported formats beyond these three.

support.subject: As a power user, I can import tokens in bulk from other authenticator apps instead of re-enrolling every account by hand

citations.quote: Google Authenticator (QR code): Import from Google Authenticator using a QR code... LastPass (JSON): Import a LastPass Authenticator account export... 2FAS (.2fas): Import a 2FAS backup file
